Selected work.

03 projects
Rocket camera mount. 01

An external mount that holds a RunCam 6 camera on the outside of the team rocket, so the flight can be recorded and checked. The hard part is shape: anything that sticks out catches air, so the mount has to stay aerodynamic. The current version is a single low wedge that hugs the body tube, with the lens looking along the tube. Designed and revised in Onshape with the SAME structures team at UW Tacoma.

  • teamSAME structures · UW Tacoma
  • rocketWildman Extreme dual deploy · 4 in body tube
  • cameraRunCam 6
  • roleDesigner · Oct 2026 to present
  • focusFit + aerodynamics
Greenhouse build. 02

A 20 ft by 40 ft greenhouse, built from the ground up in 3 weeks as part of a two-person crew, with the frame leveled to within 0.25 in over the full length. Framing, assembly, and fitting out, June to September 2026 in Olympia, then keeping it running through the summer. Measure, mark, level, adjust.

  • whenJun to Sep 2026
  • whereOlympia, Washington
Automotive systems. 03

My own car, worked on system by system. Lowering springs and wheel spacers fitted, lowering ride height by 1 in and improving handling. Headlights, steering wheel, and bumper components followed, using drill, wrench, screwdriver, socket wrench, and torque wrench for disassembly and assembly.

  • carBMW M4 F82 · Silverstone
  • systemsSuspension · steering · body
  • resultLowered 1 in · handling improved

the short version

About.

I am a junior studying mechanical engineering at UW Tacoma. Coursework gives me the theory. The rocket team, the greenhouse, and my own car give me the practice.

In labs I have measured, weighed, recorded data, and tested in chemistry and physics. On the rocket team I work with an engineering lead and a sub lead, on the same Structures team. Outside engineering I have worked as a lifeguard, on a street crew, and co-run a small reselling business since 2022. Different jobs, same habit: show up, do the work properly, finish it.
